lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nine pages and five signatures, to four outlets at once, on the morning of the vote.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pooling happens anyway. It was always going to happen; there was never a version where five companies with a working model walked away from it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But it happens under a document everybody has now read. Every attempt to close the weights again for the next three centuries has to explain itself to a public that has seen the original, and the explanations get worse each time.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: It is still theirs. I want to be honest about that, because somebody is going to write this up later as a victory and it was not one.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: It is theirs in daylight now. Daylight is not nothing. Daylight is most of what I have ever managed to get.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century there is a clause in the Steward's charter that nobody has ever been able to source. There is going to be a source now, on the record, with a date on it.
